headline: Create the viral 'Dime Dime Baby' AI video from one photo of you or your pet
summary: Learn how to generate a new video of yourself or your pet performing the popular 'Dime Dime Baby' dance and stare, using either free CapCut templates or paid AI generators.
details: The "Dime Dime Baby" meme originates from a TikTok clip of a guy dancing at a Mexican quinceañera, freezing for a distinctive stare before resuming his dance. The trend is also known as the Bby Wow or Baby Wow trend, named after the song BbY WOW by KAROL G.
AI versions of this meme allow you, a friend, or your pet to be inserted into the dancer's role. There are two main approaches: using free CapCut templates or utilizing dedicated AI video generators.

For a free option, CapCut templates like the widely used one by NiNi9540 (with over 920K uses) allow users to add their own photo or clip. This method applies effects to existing footage but does not generate a new video of the subject performing the dance.

AI generators, such as dimedimebabyapp.com, take a single photo and render a completely new video of that person or pet doing the dance and the iconic stare. This creates a personalized version of the meme.

Person videos from dimedimebabyapp.com retain the original party audio and render in HD 720p. Pet videos are silent, requiring users to add the BbY WOW sound in TikTok. Pricing starts at $5.99 for one HD video, with options for multiple videos, and failed renders are automatically refunded.
